name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Replays jump taps you made just before landing. Change the strength in the mod settings (or press F6 on desktop).

stage.name: Buffer stage
stage.description: 1: 2 ticks, 2: 4 ticks, 3: 8 ticks, 4: 16 ticks, 5: off. A tick is 1/240 s (4 ticks is about 1 frame at 60 FPS).
